167. One should not believe that **forms** <note>In this context, the "form" is the non-physical blueprint or soul that gives matter its identity and life.</note> existing in matter generate others similar to themselves. Generating is actually a property of bodies. It is, however, the right and duty of the form to move its organs harmoniously, and through them to prepare the **seminal matter** <note>The physical substance used for reproduction.</note> for generation. The form encloses a ray of light or a secret spark of life within this matter, like a hidden treasure. It also imprints its own specific character upon that **vivifying spirit** <note>original: "Spiritui viuifico." This is the active, subtle life-force that mediates between soul and body.</note> hidden within the seed. During the process of generation, by means of a pulsating heat and at a fixed time, this spirit unfolds itself into a **Soul** <note>original: "Animam."</note>, whether it be vegetative <note>The soul responsible for growth and nutrition in plants.</note> or animal <note>The soul responsible for sensation and movement in animals.</note>. In this way, that which was a secret and formal spirit in the seed becomes the **Form** in the completed mixture. Thus, what was hidden in the bosom of Nature is made manifest, and

<summary>This page explains that species achieve immortality through the replacement of individuals. It details how the non-physical form directs the body to prepare seed and imprints a spark of life that eventually unfolds into a soul.</summary>
<keywords>immortality of species, generation, seminal matter, vivifying spirit, vegetative soul, animal soul, nature, metaphysics</keywords>
